request_timeout.hint: 统一用于 SearXNG、GitHub、网页抓取等外部请求

image_result_limit.description: 图片搜索最终返回数量上限
image_result_limit.hint: Metadata results only; maximum 10. Images are not automatically downloaded.

image_candidate_limit.description: 图片搜索预筛选候选数量
image_candidate_limit.hint: Maximum 20 metadata candidates. No HEAD probes or image downloads.

guard_enabled.hint: Optional. Disabled results are explicitly marked unscanned. Enabled screening fails closed.

guard_api_url.hint: Administrator-configured HTTP(S) base URL, without /v1/scan or credentials. Save/reload, then open the plugin Connection Test view to verify.

guard_auth_token.hint: Stored in local AstrBot configuration. Do not include in logs or bug reports.

guard_timeout.hint: 1–60. Failures withhold external content when screening is enabled.
